method.touching: at least one shared code point; adjacent half-open intervals do not count
method.search: identical candidate locations deduplicated across channels; final duplicates remain distinct
method.labels: flag-only metrics; uncertain locations and decisions also reported separately
method.interval: 95% percentile; undefined replicates omitted and counted
method.clusters: documents for genre; contrast families and before/after external revisions stay paired
method.complete: all intended search channels covered, no search error, valid final/quorum when requested
method.end_to_end: use any actually delivered flags; unavailable empty output is never a correct clean decision
method.target: IoU >= 0.5 at supplied locus; a valid free search with no proposal there implies keep
method.accuracy: three-way exact; technical unavailability counts as incorrect in end-to-end denominators
method.filter_missed: candidate maximum matches minus final maximum matches; includes merge/quorum losses
